office_does: The district court judge hears misdemeanors, traffic infractions, small claims and civil cases up to the statutory limit for the Lower Kittitas County district (Ellensburg, Kittitas, Thorp, Vantage and the rest of the lower county).
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Paul Sander, on the Lower Kittitas County District Court since 2018, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Lower Kittitas County District Court judge since 2018, running unopposed.
highlights: Helped create the county's Department of Public Defense and a multi-district Behavioral Health Court [S1]
